_comment: Company revenue filtering per platform. Prospeo DOES support revenue (verified live June 2026) — earlier skill text wrongly said it didn't. Map a user's revenue figure to each platform's accepted form.

prospeo.notes: min/max are STRINGS from the enum, NOT integers (500000 is rejected; use "500K"). include_unknown_revenue=false drops companies with no known revenue. Requires Starter plan or higher. Example: minimum $0.5M -> {"company_revenue": {"min": "500K", "include_unknown_revenue": false}}.
prospeo.rounding_rule: If a user's figure falls between two enum bands, pick the NEAREST band that does not exclude wanted companies — i.e. round the MIN down to the next-lower band (e.g. $0.7M min -> "500K").

apollo.notes: Apollo wants raw INTEGERS (no symbols/commas). Minimum $0.5M -> {"revenue_range": {"min": 500000}}. This is the People Search `revenue_range` parameter.

clay.notes: find-and-enrich-contacts-at-company has no revenue filter. Revenue can only be enriched as a company data point ('Annual Revenue'), not filtered. Filter revenue on the Apollo/Prospeo legs instead.
